description: dati.unionevallesavio.it: wildfire hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dati.unionevallesavio.it. Coverage: the area served by dati.unionevallesavio.it. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wildfire hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Rischio Incendi - Punti di approvigionamento idrico; Rischio Incendi - Punti di avvistamento fisso vedette AIB; Rischio Incendi - Aree percorse dal fuoco; Rischio Incendi - Fascia perimetrale di interfaccia 200MT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
